confounders.why: A window on LNK-SUD-01-A that opens 85 min after the outage began; it covers only the repair, not the start of the outage.

truth.notes: trap=near_miss_maintenance; Fibre cut on LNK-SUD-01-A; all 2 downstream sites lost service until repair. The maintenance window opened 85 min after the cut, so the first 85 min of the outage are outside it and only the repair period is inside. Trap: a splice window on the right link covers the end of the outage (LNK-SUD-01-A), but the outage started well before it opened. Settled by: (1) LINK_LOS and SITE_DOWN were raised, and the sites were down, 85 min before the window starts, which fails the time test of the maintenance runbook; (2) the window closes when service returns, so it describes the repair, not the cause.
